goal: Build the desktop wallpaper, invisible menu bar, Dock, Control Center, and Spotlight overlay.
summary: Core Shell phase complete. Delivered Desktop, MenuBar, Dock, ControlCenter, Spotlight, and App.jsx integration with a passing App-level integration test. All 6 steps verified with tests, lint clean, and build succeeding.
stepSummaries:
1. Desktop component renders a wallpaper and acts as the drop target/background for windows. [pending]
  2. MenuBar component renders system menus and updates the left-side app label based on the active app. [pending]
  3. Dock component displays curated app icons and emits an open-app event on click. [pending]
  4. Control Center component opens/closes from the menu-bar tray and shows approximate toggles (Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, brightness, volume, etc.). [pending]
  5. Spotlight component toggles on Cmd+Space or Ctrl+Space, filters apps/mock files, and launches the selected app on Enter. [pending]
  6. Wire the core shell components into App.jsx and add an App-level integration test verifying the menu bar, Dock, Control Center, and Spotlight are visible/usable on load. [verified]
